description: Add a terminal strip (auto-tagged TB1, TB2…). Usually fix_fanouts creates strips for you; use this for planned strips. Its terminals use `block` if given, else the project default block, else a generic block (terminal_type, clamps_per_side).

block.description: Terminal block part for this strip: part id or part number, or "PE" for the project's PE block. Omit for the project default.

name: add_terminal_strip
title: Add terminal strip
